description: Built May 1975; delivered 23 June 1975; registered 16 July 1975 as CCCP-87522 to the Urals Civil Aviation Directorate at Chelyabinsk-Balandino; transferred to the Tajik Civil Aviation Directorate at Dushanbe 14 January 1988; to Tajik Air as EY-87522 in 1992-93; withdrawn 2004 and stored at Dushanbe; struck off 2012 and handed to the M. S. Osimi Tajik Technical University as an instructional airframe on 3 September 2012; year_built from the registry's stated build month
